diagnosis.independentCrossCheck: FFmpeg decoded all 288 PNGs to the same raw-frame MD5 54ec01ea1df4d1a447d83af35a1c2a18; nine representative RGBA raw-frame SHA-256 values were all 6b98542ed82c2cf177caf34601e2ef02764cfc5ad8258a604536f9ff8b723048.
diagnosis.renderReportState: The renderer recorded correct pre-render marker/camera applications, but sceneCameraAfterRender was CAM_WIDE_APPROACH for every inspected medium and close frame.
diagnosis.cause: The isolated Scene was passed through bpy.ops.render.render(scene=name), but it was not the active Blender context Scene. Its scene.frame_set calls therefore did not drive the evaluated animation/camera/light context consumed by the render operator, yielding a frozen frame while PNG container bytes varied.

authorizedChanges.renderer: Remove the newly created isolated render Scene. Use the exact loaded T1 production Scene in memory, require it to be bpy.context.scene and the active window Scene when a window exists, apply the frozen Eevee/color/output settings without saving, set frame and update the active view layer, derive and assign exact marker/camera, then call bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True) without the scene-name override.
authorizedChanges.sourceIntegrity: Hash the source .blend before rendering and again after all renders; require byte identity and record it. The operator may mutate only in-memory Scene render settings, frame and active camera. It may not save the Scene.
authorizedChanges.frameReceipt: Every row additionally records contextScene and contextFrame immediately before render. Node requires exact production Scene name, frame number, marker and camera for all 288 rows.
authorizedChanges.runnerAndNodeAuditor: Bind C3 and immutable v0.1, v0.2 and v0.3 trees, move to fresh v0.4, and retain the original 14 gates and outcome-neutral mapping.
authorizedChanges.freshExecution: Render all 288 frames again from the source. No image, report or video from v0.1-v0.3 may be reused.
